thread:
Iris: Heads-up for the weekly KPI review: the launch-posts slide shows anomalous CPL drop but our pipeline flags fewer raw leads. Need a quick triage before finalizing.
Connor: Saw it when updating the deck. CPMs same, clicks up slightly, leads down ~30% vs cohort baseline.
Bella: any known infra quirks? I saw a brief deploy to the form handler yesterday afternoon.
deploy-bot: deploy completed: form-handler v2.14 -> v2.15 at 2026-03-21T15:03:12Z by @Sam.
Sam: that deploy included a change to the client-side payload shape (added campaign_id). I validated locally but didn't catch an edge case for older browsers.
analytics-bot: quick-check: last 24h click->lead conversion normally 2.4%. Observed 1.7% for 'launch_posts' cohort starting 2026-03-21 15:10 UTC. No cohort window change.
Iris: can someone pull raw click + lead join for 15:00-16:00 UTC so we know whether events are missing or malformed?
Connor: running minute-grained query now, will paste snippet.
Connor: ```sql
SELECT date_trunc('minute', ts) minute, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event='click') clicks, count(*) FILTER (WHERE event='lead') leads
FROM events_raw
WHERE campaign='launch_posts' AND ts >= '2026-03-21 15:00:00' AND ts < '2026-03-21 16:00:00'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
```
Connor: summary: clicks 1,120; leads 7 (expected ~27).
Bella: that's worrying. Sam, does the new payload change the server parsing? If lead posts now require campaign_id and older clients don't send it, they might be rejected.
Sam: looking at server logs now : I see 422s for payload validation around 15:08-15:25 UTC. The client lib didn't include campaign_id for browsers running an older cached version.
Iris: okay two-fold: client caching + server validation made some leads be rejected. Can we patch server to accept legacy payloads gracefully while we roll a client fix?
Sam: yes, toggling compatibility mode now (feature-flag: accept-legacy-campaign). Rolling to 10% then 100% if green.
Connor: backfill check: if the leads were rejected we won't be able to reconstruct them later unless the client retried. Any retry logic?
Sam: client does a 3-attempt retry for network errs but not for 422. If the client never sent campaign_id, no retry will re-send with it. We can try to recover partials from access logs (payloads without campaign_id) and reconcile by creating synthetic lead records, but that requires legal/product signoff.
Bella: product likely ok with synthetic match if we tag them as reconciled in the deck, but need to be explicit. Iris, can you confirm?
Iris: yes, but include an annotation: "reconciled from server access logs, marked as provisional" and get a quick OK from legal.
analytics-bot: estimated reconciliation potential: up to +18 leads in the window based on raw POST volume without campaign_id.
Connor: action items: 1) Sam to keep compatibility flag live and deploy client quick-patch for cached browsers. 2) Connor to run access-log reconciliation and submit list for legal. 3) Bella to update the KPI slide with a data-quality footnote and flag provisional numbers.
Sam: compatibility flag at 10% is healthy, rolling to 100% now. Client patch pushed to CDN with cache-buster query param.
Bella: drafting slide note: "15:08-15:25 UTC: payload validation rejected some leads due to client-server schema mismatch; server compat toggled; reconciliation in progress."
Iris: for the benchmark narrative, please include a 1-line callout in the webinar planning notes so hosts don't misinterpret conversion claims when referencing launch numbers.
Connor: reconciliation job queued (job_id: recon-3098765439). I'll post results when done.
analytics-bot: recon-estimate completed: +15 provisional leads found, final reconciliation pending legal approval.
Iris: thanks all. We'll present baseline KPIs with a footnote and mark the reconciled numbers as provisional. Nora from comms will want to hold any external claims until finalized. Closing this thread; ping me if legal denies synthetic reconciliation. :white_check_mark:
